<title level="1" right="Trait">[Venomous](/Traits.aspx?ID=785)</title>

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 57

These weapons inject poison into every hit. When you hit a creature with this weapon, it deals an additional 1 [persistent poison damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=86). This increases to 2 persistent poison damage if the weapon has a [greater striking rune](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2829).
name: Venomous
